---
name: Issue readme


---

## BEFORE REPORTING
1: are you sure you aren't accidentally running this from source

2: if you are intentionally running from source, check what version of Godot are you using. If it doesn't say "mono" at the end you downloaded the wrong one.

3: check for issues describing the same problem

## WHAT HELPS

- Including what operating system you are running
- A screenshot of the console (either the .sh or the small .exe file depending on what version)
- A guide on how to replicate the issue


If your issue is really vague EX "It doesn't work" it will just be deleted/ closed as there's no way for me to know what your problem is.
